ValidationRule.description: Ensures all related transactions are Completed when a case status is updated from Pending Payment to Closed. Also ensures all Penalties Assessed are Collected.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL( Status__c , "Closed" ), ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE(Status__c) , "Pending Payment" ), OR(Total_of_Transactions__c != Total_of_Completed_Transactions__c, PenaltiesCollected__c < PenaltiesAssessed__c ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please ensure all related transactions have a status of Completed before updating a case from Pending Payment to Closed. Please also ensure all Penalties Assessed have been Collected.
